503 Error On Fedora 22 Server Using Apache 2.4 and Mono

Well I didn't get a response, but I hate it when I lookup an issue, and find someone else had the same problem as me, but never made the fix clear, so I am here to answer my own question.

Fedora 22 Server was running SELinux, and this was interfering with the permissions needed for mod_mono to run. I was able to see that these settings were on by checking with the following command: getenforce

Then to temporarily change the setting I used the following command to change the setting to "Permissive": setenforce 0

Then to verify the change was effective I checked the setting again with: getenforce

Finally I restarted the Apache Server with the following command: apachectl restart

I refreshed the web browser and the page loaded correctly. After a last check of the error log to be sure this change did not cause another problem I hadn't yet seen, I decided to make this setting permanent.

To make the setting permanant I used the following command, to edit the selinux file: nano /etc/sysconfig/selinux

Finally to ensure this fixed the problem I rebooted the server, and tried to load the webpage again. Eureka! everything is working.
